name: js-libraries
description: Recognises the JavaScript libraries your targets serve (jQuery, Bootstrap, AngularJS, React, Vue, Lodash, Moment and others) and records each version found as a finding, from the script's URL or its banner comment. Each exact version is looked up on osv.dev, and every known vulnerability is raised as a finding of its own with a link to its osv.dev page. It sends library names and version numbers (never your targets' addresses) to api.osv.dev.

settings.label: Look versions up on osv.dev
settings.description: Each library version is sent to api.osv.dev once a day at most (the answers are kept), and every known vulnerability becomes a finding. Off: versions are recorded, and nothing is sent.

settings.label: Check libraries your targets load from public CDNs
settings.description: Scripts from cdnjs, jsDelivr, unpkg, code.jquery.com, Google's and Microsoft's CDNs and the like, when a page on a target asked for them (its Referer or Origin is on a target). A page that sends no Referer is missed.

settings.label: Largest script to read (KiB)
settings.description: Scripts larger than this are judged by their URL only.
